Normal Presure Filling Machine 3-In-1 Unit

The series of machines are the integrated washing, filling and capping machines, mainly suitable for producing the bottled drinking water, fruit juice, milk, yogurt and so on.

Contact

The series of machines are the integrated washing, filling and capping machines, mainly suitable for producing the bottled drinking water, fruit juice, milk, yogurt and so on, production capacity from 3000 to 36000 bottles per hour, with feature of simple design, low cost of production and maintenance, filling accuracy, low energy consumption, computer control, simple operation, flexible filling speed and strong adaptability.
